callouts.label: Notice Who Is Left Out
callouts.hint: The student at far left observing two classmates sitting apart.
callouts.description: Upstander action begins by noticing exclusion, bullying, or rising tension.
callouts.tip: Observe enough to choose a safe response; do not assume every conflict is bullying.

callouts.label: Invite and Include
callouts.hint: The students opening a basketball game to another player.
callouts.description: A direct invitation can reduce exclusion and create belonging.
callouts.tip: Invite without forcing someone to participate.

callouts.label: Interrupt Calmly
callouts.hint: The pair near the entrance using a calm open-hand gesture.
callouts.description: When it is safe, a brief statement can name the problem and interrupt it.
callouts.tip: Students are never required to confront someone who may become violent.

callouts.label: Distract or Redirect
callouts.hint: The group shifting attention toward a different activity.
callouts.description: A distraction can break a harmful moment without escalating it.
callouts.tip: Redirection is useful when direct confrontation would not be safe.

callouts.label: Move Toward Safety
callouts.hint: The student walking toward a visible safe group and open hallway.
callouts.description: Help the targeted person reach a safer place or group.
callouts.tip: Distance and support matter more than winning an argument.

callouts.label: Get a Trusted Adult
callouts.hint: The student speaking with school staff beside the building.
callouts.description: Adults have responsibility and authority to respond to bullying and possible violence.
callouts.tip: Keep telling trusted adults until the concern is addressed.

callouts.label: Document Safely
callouts.hint: The student holding a device near the lockers in the lower-left inset.
callouts.description: Documentation may help only when school policy allows and it does not increase risk.
callouts.tip: Never share harmful footage for attention.

callouts.label: Support Afterward
callouts.hint: The peer sitting beside and comforting another student in the garden inset.
callouts.description: Private support after an incident can reduce isolation.
callouts.tip: Listen, believe the person, and offer to go with them for help.

callouts.label: Report Possible Fighting
callouts.hint: The student approaching an adult before tension grows.
callouts.description: Warning signs of a possible fight should be reported before anyone is hurt.
callouts.tip: Do not step between people who may fight.

callouts.label: Follow Up and Restore Belonging
callouts.hint: The calm counselor-office conversation in the lower-right inset.
callouts.description: Check in later and help rebuild a welcoming environment.
callouts.tip: Upstander work includes prevention and follow-through, not only the immediate moment.
